checked.how: Read the whole diff. It touches only src/game.ts, src/sim/world.ts and two new tests. It changes no file under src/ui, no CSS and no stage, and adds no colour, font or pixel literals and no materials. game.ts only passes drivers.map(d => d.body / number / name) into the existing ui.reset().

The dots use existing token classes ui-hud-map__car--<palette> with var(--color-*) fills and an ink outline. The navy (BRUNO) dot gets a cream ring (hud.css:105-107), so it doesn't vanish on the navy map panel, as UI_RULES §10 requires. The player dot uses the larger PLAYER_R radius. No change needed.

The roster names and numbers (YOU #1, KOSKI #7, BRUNO #23, DEL RIO #4, MAGS #9, OTTO #12) match the spec exactly. AI bodies are mustard/navy/teal/cream/grass and never red (UI_RULES §8). The player is rally-red with a cream stripe.

Opened it. HUD shows POS 1/2 and only 2 cars. That is expected: race screenshots come from the protected driver, which calls startRace without carCount (default 2). The plan audit accepted this and sent it to the owner as a backlog change request. So no screenshot shows the six-car grid, and the 6-dot minimap and /6 POS were checked in code only.

Opened it. This stage existed before tonight and the diff doesn't change it. It already covers a results table with more than 6 rows, so a 6-row table needs no new stage. No new screen or state was added, so no new stage is required.
There is no CSS or DOM change in the diff, so there is nothing to check against these rules. Searched the diff for rgba/opacity/gradient/hex/px: no matches in the changed src files.
